items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Lucien and me and Charlie Barbarin, we have two sons... Lucien and Charlie Barbarin, we were teaching them traditional music

ctx.x: So who were some of the guys that turned out to be musicians along with you when you were growing up?

Well, you'd see them, you'd see all the kids. Well, I didn't pay him no mind, but there was one little youngster, he's about what...about fourteen -- Crump, they called him. ...(?)... Charlie Barbarin's wife; he was his uncle. Crump. He was a little-bitty cat, a little light cat who looked like could be a Spaniard, had pretty black curly hair with big waves in it, and he wore sideburns as a... He didn't have them then, but later on he had these big heavy sideburns. But he played clarinet and saxophone, and I…
